description: Default Topaz Video AI upscale preset, translated from the r/AIRemastered non-generative upscaling guide onto current Topaz Video AI model names (verified against this machine's installed models). Edit freely -- this is meant to be tuned per title/series over time, not treated as gospel.

encoder._note: Topaz's bundled ffmpeg (needed for the tvai_up filter) has no libx264 -- only hardware encoders -- so h264_nvenc is the only option in this same process. Lower cq = higher quality/bigger files.
